decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The London Borough of Hounslow as the Local Planning Authority hereby certify that on 22 June 2005, the single storey rear extension measuring 6.3 metres wide, 3.61 metres deep (plus overhang at rear) and 3.05 metres high reducing to 2.92 metres high at eaves was not lawful within the meaning of Section 191 and 192 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 for the following reason:

The development exceeds the provisions of Schedule 2, Part 1, Class A of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 1995 because the volume of the extension, the existing front extension and the rear garage results in the proposal exceeding the permitted development limit.

Condition : 2 - Informative:

You are recommended to apply for planning permission in order to remedy this breach of planning control.
description: Certificate of Lawfulness for the erection of a single storey rear extension to house.
